story.title: The forest falls, then burns
story.lede: Along the roads of Rondônia, forest gives way to pasture in a fishbone pattern. Watch whole stands drop out of the forest corner of the floor.
body: Standing rainforest sits high on the floor because its leaves and branches scatter the radar in every direction, which is what HV hears. When a stand is cut, that volume disappears and its dots fall several decibels in a single pass.

In the dry season the felled trees are burned. Fire strips what is left of the canopy, so burned hectares slide further toward bare soil. NISAR sees all of it through the smoke and the clouds of the wet season.

beats.caption: Wet season. Clouds hide the ground from optical satellites, but not from radar.
Dry season clearing begins: new patches fall out of the forest.
Fire escapes into standing forest east of the road.
By October the new clearings have joined the pasture.

highlight.label: Hectares that fall, burn, and stand still
